duties.duty: assessment_dispute: ED26-P15-CH-characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments-C024: Durrett Exercise 3.3.24 (p.143) asks to show nu_k^{1/k} -> Lambda, 'so the assumption of Theorem 3.3.26 holds if Lambda < infinity'. The body (handbook/parts/p15/characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments.tex lines 451-463) claims to supply Exercise 3.3.24. The annex (handbook/annex/p15/characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments.tex lines 1038-1077) proves the limit and proves compact determinacy by polynomial approximation. Nowhere on the route is it written that Lambda < infinity gives limsup m_{2k}^{1/(2k)}/(2k) < infinity, so the exercise's second clause is missing.
